provenance: Tibet 13 secret stage (world 2, level 12, menu 13) normal exit 32,8 (object 5, result exit), control-only from the spawn on the exact S700 core (engine s700-core-2, logic and paint every frame). Tick numbers count frames played (show.ts --cut=N). Start values: weaponTier 8 (ice hammer from the Tibet 6 chest 32,22; Tibet 7+ may start with it and Tibet 13 is revisited after Tibet 6; the ice hammer is used once, to freeze the ice creature, and the hook (tier >= 2) moves the stones and the vent), maxHealth 4 (no armor), lives 12 (campaign value of the old routes; no life is lost), diamonds/redDiamonds 0 (per stage). diving true: the Bavaria 8 diving item (chest 20,12, behind a riddle room). Why diving is needed: the lower bridge switch 12,19 can only be struck from 12,18, and while the bridges are in the state that admits the hero to the lower half (bridge 28,15 open) the only way to 12,18 is gate 2 at 11,18, which only stays open while an object rests on plate 9,18 (cGame.method_316; method_258 closes it at once). On that side the only movable objects are the stone 7,21 and the vent W 5,19 (tile 47, which lifts objects above it through object-35 cells, method_311/method_307). The water source 8,16 (26 units, method_293/method_372) floods the basin x=4..9 rows 21..25 by about frame 130, long before the hero can arrive; the stone floats at the surface 7,21 and the vent floats too (method_351), so the stone can never be brought above the vent's lift from dry ground. A macro search of the room (walk, push, hook, strike, wait) without diving runs out after 6 states with gate 2 shut. Tibet 14, entered from this stage, needs the same item (routes/2-tibet-14-exit.json), and the seal opens Bavaria (10 red diamonds) before Tibet (25). The magic diamond lock listed at 31,8 (45 diamonds) does not block in this S700 logic (the loader clears the tile and keeps only the counter, here 45 -> 3); the hero walks through the cell. Route: walk in (checkpoint 4,5 at t17). Hammer the brick rows 6..8,8 (from 6,7) and 10..12,8 (from 9,8). Strike the bridge switch 15,8 from 16,8; the bridges flip by t228 (15,5, 22,5 and 15,11 open; 20,3, 18,8 and 28,15 closed). The diamonds 15,3 and 15,4 drop through 15,5: collect them at 14,10 and 15,7. Climb column 15, collect 16..19,3 and walk into the chest 8,2 (25 diamonds, t460, 31 in total). Go down through 15,11 into the pocket and, from 20,15, hook the stone 22,15 (t648): it moves to 21,15 and the diamond shaft above drops by one. Strike the switch from 16,8 again (bridges back by t804), cross 18,8, collect the shaft 22,9..22,15 from the top (t863-888) and push the stone 21,15 west twice to 19,15 (t909): the shaft now joins the east corridor and the pocket. Collect 22,15 and 22,14, recross 18,8 and strike the switch from 16,8 (bridge 22,5 open by t1044), go down 15,11, through the pocket and up the shaft to 22,4. Step into 21,4 to drop the ceiling trap 21,1 and step back, climb 21,3 and 21,2 and walk into the chest 22,2 (silver key, t1310). Go back down to row 8 (the other ceiling traps fall without hitting the hero) and walk into the silver lock 25,7 from 24,7 (gate 0, t1435); checkpoint 26,8 at t1505. Return through the shaft and the pocket to 15,9 and strike the switch upward (28,15 open again by t1672). Go down the right column (one snake bite at 27,11, t1776, hp 4 -> 3), over bridge 28,15, west along row 21 under the ceiling traps (each drops behind the hero) and row 22, up column 14 and along row 15 to checkpoint 10,16 (t1983). Plate room: swim to 8,21 and push the floating stone west onto the ledge 4,21; from 7,19 hook the vent W, which drops into the water at 6,21 (t2161). Swim to 9,23 and walk into the grass 10,23 (cut at t2232): the basin drains into the closed pocket below to rows 24-25, the vent settles on the water at 6,24 with its lift column 6,17..6,23, and the stone stays dry on the ledge. From 7,21 a west hook pulls the stone into 6,21, inside the lift, which carries it to 6,17; from 9,17 a west hook pulls it to 8,17 and it drops to 8,19. Swim to 5,24 and push the vent one cell east to 7,24 (t2790; lift column 7,17..7,23). From 6,19 an east hook pulls the stone to 7,19 and the lift carries it to 7,17; from 10,17 a west hook pulls it to 9,17 and it drops onto plate 9,18 (t3013): gate 2 opens and stays open. Walk through gate 2 to 12,18 and strike the switch 12,19 (13,18, 15,18 and 25,18 open by t3129). The ice creature comes over bridge 15,18 to 13,18; freeze it there with the ice hammer, push the ice block east so it drops down column 14, walk to 20,18 and into the chest 20,19 (gold key, t3327). Back at 12,18 strike the switch again (28,15 open by t3432), leave through gate 2, go along row 15, down column 14, east along row 21 to 26,21 and up to 28,14; wait 38 frames for the two patrolling snakes and run up column 28 to 28,9 without a hit, walk into the gold lock 30,7 from 29,7 (gate 1, t3704) and walk east through gate 1 and the cleared lock cell 31,8 to the exit 32,8. Result: exit at tick 3787 (hero at 41,8, state 35), hp 3, 42 diamonds, one damage, no deaths, no resets.
